meta.title: Multi-Provider Web Search
meta.description: Adds Tavily, Exa, Parallel, TinyFish, Firecrawl, Linkup, Brave, Kagi, Perplexity, Serper, Jina, SearXNG and Mojeek as web_search backends, plus Tavily, Exa, Firecrawl and Jina as web_fetch backends. Pick the active engine through the web service's provider settings.
